title: B-018 defect fix: stranded-START_CLAUDE recovery window (smallest durable re-entry path)
objective: QUALIFYING EVIDENCE (supervisor-freeze section 2/3): B-018 - a reproduced, unresolved crash/recovery problem discovered by the first live supervised product run (2026-08-08). The window: an external kill between the preflight_pass->START_CLAUDE journal commit and the worker launch strands the journal at START_CLAUDE; CYCLE_ENTRY_STATES (tools/agent_supervisor/loop.py:118) omits START_CLAUDE, so every subsequent operator start refuses with bad_cycle_entry_state even after recover_boot classifies SAFE_CHECKPOINT - no CLI or production path drives the S7 exits (claude_start_failed->HALTED->owner_explicit_restart->IDLE), so recovery required the owner. OWNER ORDER (D-010 source-024, R237-R241): treat as a real reliability defect; implement and test the SMALLEST durable fix so a future claude_start_failed/stranded-start event recovers through an authorized deterministic path without the owner each time; NO supervisor redesign; do not interrupt M2-T015 (disjoint file scope). PROPOSED SMALLEST FIX (producer verifies or refutes): admit START_CLAUDE to CYCLE_ENTRY_STATES - the state means 'about to launch, nothing launched'; run_cycle already skips the duplicate preflight_pass transition (entry==PREFLIGHT guard), already transitions START_CLAUDE->CLAUDE_RUNNING on real process start, and dispatch remains gated by the operator start command + recover_boot SAFE_CHECKPOINT classification + single-instance lock + child accounting + Job-Object kill-on-close containment. REQUIRED TESTS (adversarial, real-journal): (1) crash-window regression - journal committed to START_CLAUDE with no recorded/surviving children, restart dispatches exactly-once and reaches CLAUDE_RUNNING with a fake executable; (2) fail-closed negative - recover_boot classification not SAFE (e.g. competing writer or unaccounted child) still refuses dispatch from START_CLAUDE; (3) the full supervisor suite re-establishes the M0-T039 freeze baseline (0 failures). Change scope is loop.py plus tests only; any wider need is a STOP-and-report, not scope growth.
business_reason: Owner directive source-024 after B-018: supervised-runtime reliability must not depend on per-incident owner intervention; the fix keeps the R595-activated supervised-auto path operable across crash windows without weakening any fail-closed gate.
forbidden_paths: tools/agent_supervisor/** (every other supervisor module: the fix is loop.py entry-state admission only; any wider need is STOP-and-report)
services/**, apps/**, packages/** (M2-T015 scope stays untouched - R241)
